title: Siege of Uehara
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Uehara", at revision 1370746154, opens: "The siege of Uehara was the first of many steps taken by Takeda Shingen in his bid to seize control of Shinano Province. Uehara Castle had been controlled by Suwa Yorishige before it was taken by Shingen." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2183299, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1541 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
